payload.C1forced_design: 10 forced-Prim paraphrases F1-F10 (corrupt) vs their ' .' padding twins (clean) as pairs; F11-F15 and their padding twins as the 10 held-out validation prompts (no Prim paraphrase set exists in art_MZAfDPVhM6Ui beyond its single wording, so the 15 wordings are written here); C1-nat is still screened and reported descriptively; C1mix uses F1-F5
payload.metric_readout: m read in fp32 from the bf16 final-norm hidden state (h . (W_a - W_b)); the bf16 lm_head output is quantised to 0.125-0.25 nats

F5_decision.rule: suffix forwards are kept when their mean deviation from full recompute is no larger than 1.5 x the full-vs-full batch-shape noise + 0.02 nats (both are bf16 path noise and cancel within each in-chunk base-row comparison); otherwise every row is a full forward

payload.generation_alignment_rule: TOP5 for generation = the five highest-ranked top-10 nodes whose position class aligns with the B3 twin prompt; COND nodes of C1forced (the forced instruction span) have no counterpart in the twin's condition sentence and are skipped (the next-ranked node fills in); RAND5 = one matched draw per generation node (seed 8303)
